import sqlite3
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
import pandas as pd

# Set high precision context
getcontext().prec = 50

# Connect to database

# Engine A: SQL Implementation

    SELECT printf('%.20f', 
    CAST(SUM(monthly_revenue_avg) AS NUMERIC)) AS sum_result
    FROM quickbooks__customer_analytics
""", conn)

# Convert to Decimal, handling NULLs

for value in df['monthly_revenue_avg']:
    if pd.notna(value):
        decimal_sum += Decimal(str(value))

# Format to 20 decimal places

print(f"{py_result}")

# Compare results

    print("Consider increasing precision further")

conn.close()
